name: print-social-bauhaus-tile-border-post-with-red-green-and-yellow-shapes
title: Post with a Bauhaus tile border of red, green, yellow and grey quarter-circles and triangles
whatItIs: A square white post with a border of geometric tiles (quarter-circles, triangles, squares) in red, green, yellow, grey and photo-filled blocks, a photo of a smiling woman in multicoloured sunglasses and a yellow sweater, a black and red headline 'Your Headline Goes Here.' and a pill URL.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and modern; the tile grid adds playful structure and picks up the sunglass colours.
techniques: Frame content with a border of geometric tiles.
Pull the palette from a detail in the photo.
Split the headline into black and red lines.

vocabulary.definition: Simple circles, triangles and squares in primary colours.
A frame made from repeating units.
